selection: 79 unmapped VS with strong unknown-shader independent scene/depth evidence; review includes all 186 observed VS/PS pairs, including pairs without strong records.
limits: Reviewed source decisions, not an automatic map generator. Synthetic CPU arithmetic and immutable-upload tests do not establish GPU pixels, producer identity, future PS pairings, or player acceptance. Runtime remains a VS-wide allowlist.

candidates.outputs: o6 copies clip; PS uses initial o6.w for alpha and overwrites initial o6.xyz before later use; o2.w and UV/lighting are independent
candidates.reason: 12 strong and 19 guard-31 observations; exact PS does not use original clip XY as sample coordinates. Preserve clip W.

candidates.outputs: o6 copies clip; PS overwrites initial o6.xyz before use, while initial o6.w reaches output alpha; UV/color/lighting independent
candidates.reason: 12 strong and 13 guard-31 observations; preserve clip W and independent varyings.
candidates.control_flow_review: PS 4d5c5950fbf2614b: initial i6.xyz copied to r6 is unconditionally overwritten at HLSL lines 461/465/481 before any use; first r6 texture lookup follows at 506. Guest if(p0) begins at 762 after another unconditional r6.xyz write at 761. Both paths retain only original clip W in output alpha; no original clip XY survives.

candidates.reason: 31 strong and 39 guard-31 observations; observed pair is depth-only. Color companion not established.

candidates.outputs: UV and color independent; both PSs sample from o0 UV
candidates.reason: First PS has 24 guard-31 scene observations, but second PS has 39 finite-VP guard-29 camera-mismatch observations and no guard-31 evidence. An older six-frame capture also showed other-camera c0 and incompatible Z viewport. VS-wide mapping could jitter that other-camera use after mapped-draw self-anchoring.

candidates.outputs: o2 copies clip; PS uses initial o2.w for alpha, texture coordinates from o0 UV; o1 mask independent
candidates.reason: 12 strong and 13 guard-31 observations. Eleven kind-0/guard-13 records are unproven position results; three kind-1/guard-15 records fail finite-VP guard.

candidates.outputs: o0 UV and o1 color independent of clip; both exact PSs sample with coordinates derived from o0
candidates.reason: Both observed PS pairs have 8 strong and 8 guard-31 observations each. Two additional kind-0/guard-13 records are unproven position results.
